visual_action: A slideshow of still photos of Ron DeSantis. The images show him in various situations: shouting or laughing with his mouth wide open, shaking hands with a police officer while wearing white boots, speaking at a formal event, looking surprised, and standing somberly in front of an airplane.

cast.name: Ron DeSantis
cast.evidence: Ron DeSantis is the subject of every still image in the montage.

on_screen_text.text: you were bigger than the whole sky
you were more than just a short time

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings lyrics from a song. The lyrics include: "Goodbye, goodbye, goodbye, goodbye. You were bigger than the whole sky. You were more than just a short time... And I've got a lot to pine about, I've got a lot to live without."
audio_music: A slow, melancholic, and mournful song with a female vocalist plays throughout the video, creating an atmosphere of a sad farewell.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow of still images, with each photo displayed for several seconds.
cultural_references: The audio is from Taylor Swift's song 'Bigger Than The Whole Sky', which is about profound loss, used here to frame a political opponent's career.
central_claim: The video frames Ron DeSantis's political career as having ended in failure, using a mournful song to mock his perceived downfall.
intended_effect: To mock Ron DeSantis and encourage viewers to see his political ambitions as over.
